annotations.title: Hand a thread to a human

description: Use this when a thread needs a human, or to read that state. Requires auth. Inputs: inbox_id (omit when this key is limited to one inbox), thread_id, action (mark or status), optional reason (at most 500 characters) for mark. mark pauses agent sends on that thread and notifies verified owners. status reads needs_human or resolved. The agent cannot resume. The owner resumes with POST /api/v1/owner/agents/{inbox}/threads/{thread_id}/resume. Mail already sent is not recalled. A send on a paused thread is HTTP 409 thread_needs_human. An unknown thread is HTTP 404 thread_not_found. COOPER_HUMAN_HANDOFF=off returns HTTP 503 handoff_disabled. The default is on. Same as POST and GET /api/v1/inboxes/{id}/threads/{threadId}/handoff.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id, username, or email. Omit it when this key is limited to one inbox.

reason.description: Why a human is needed. At most 500 characters. Used when action is mark.

name: cooper_handoff_thread

outputSchema.description: Whether a thread is waiting on a human.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 time it was marked, or null when it was never marked.

reason.description: Why the thread was paused, or null.

resolved_at.description: ISO-8601 time the owner resumed it, or null.
